text_block_list.text:
The grand stage that was Mejiro McQueen's 
goal, the Tenno Sho (Spring), was just 
around the corner.

In order to show a victorious Tenno Sho 
run to her respected Mejiro elders, 
starting with the pillar of the Mejiro 
family, "Grandmother"—

Mejiro McQueen's heart swelled with an 
unyielding determination to win at all 
costs.

Meanwhile... Mejiro Ryan had also made up 
her mind to run in the Tenno Sho (Spring).
